title: Non-exclusive remedy.
officialText:
The procedures provided in section 28-204.6 for the enforcement of environmental control board judgments against owners shall be in addition to any other methods provided under any other provision of law for the enforcement of such judgments.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
